nodes.label: requestId()
nodes.rationale: Assigns every request a stable id for log correlation, forwards it to the handler and echoes it on the response. A short-circuit that throws is echoed too - the 401 or 403 an auth or CSRF layer throws comes back carrying the id, which is exactly the response someone will later go looking for. An unhandled throw is the exception: it maps to the generic 500, which deliberately carries nothing from the thrown value.

nodes.label: requestIdOf
nodes.rationale: Returns the id the request carries, or undefined when it carries none or what it carries fails the shape check. Preferred over a raw header read anywhere the value reaches a log line. It reports what the request claimed, so under trustIncoming: false name the header rather than presenting the value as the id.

nodes.label: Request-id shape check
nodes.rationale: An incoming id is accepted only if it matches ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$, else a fresh randomUuid is generated. The check is what stops a client-controlled string forging whole log records through an embedded newline, and it keeps a hostile value out of a response header.
